europe_now.title: US and Denmark Reach Defense Agreement on Greenland
europe_now.summary: The United States and Denmark have reached a new agreement regarding defense and investment in Greenland. President Trump claimed permanent control over the island following the announcement.

sources.headline: US and Denmark reach deal on Greenland, Trump claims 'permanent control' over island

europe_now.title: Moody's Downgrades Poland's Credit Rating
europe_now.summary: Moody's has cut Poland's credit rating to its lowest level since 2002. The financial decision reflects growing concerns over the country's economic and fiscal outlook.

sources.headline: Moody’s cuts Poland’s credit rating to lowest level since 2002

top_stories.title: German Energy Tax Cut
top_stories.summary: Germany has implemented an energy tax cut aimed at lowering soaring petrol prices for consumers. Federal and state authorities agreed on a reduction to alleviate cost-of-living pressures.

sources.headline: Germany cuts energy tax to lower soaring petrol prices

top_stories.title: Security Warnings in France
top_stories.summary: French leadership has issued warnings regarding ongoing Russian hybrid attacks. Authorities are seeking to significantly step up energy defense measures in response.

sources.headline: France’s Macron warns of Russian ‘hybrid’ attacks, seeks to step up energy defence
